tips.text: Join any clan that already researched Wukong through recruit chat, buy the blueprints, and leave; they stay yours.
Research him in a small Ghost clan; every clan tier multiplies the resource cost, up to 100 times.
Ask clanmates to chip in Plastids before you research him; each member then gives under 1,000.
Farm the 2 Argon Crystal last, right before you build Systems; it decays every day.
Count the Nitain for crafting too; the builds take 6, on top of what research costs.
Players call Wukong one of the pricier dojo frames, mostly for the Nitain and Plastids.
